methodology.gini: Initial citizen wealth distribution is lognormal with spread tuned so the simulated Gini at founding matches the World Bank US Gini (0.418). Policy choices and shocks then move inequality away from that real-world starting point.
methodology.routine: Automation-exposure ('routine') values remain model parameters, not empirically calibrated in this pass.
methodology.wages: Each sim sector wage (in sim $k/month) = 3.08 * (sector_hourly / mean_hourly_of_5_sectors). Relative pay gaps between sectors match BLS August 2026 exactly; the 3.08 mean preserves the sim's tuned economic balance. Services wage is employment-weighted across professional/business, leisure/hospitality and other services (BLS employment, Aug 2026).

gini.name: World Bank, Gini index (SI.POV.GINI), United States

wages.name: BLS Current Employment Statistics, average hourly earnings of all employees, seasonally adjusted
